cases.prompt: A controller updates user profile with $user->update($request->all()) allowing arbitrary field injection like is_admin. State the implementation decision as JSON with keys decision, chosen_pattern, primary_reason.

A search query filters products using DB::table('products')->whereRaw("title LIKE '%" . $request->search . "%'"). State the implementation decision as JSON with keys decision, chosen_pattern, primary_reason.

A Blade comment template renders user submitted bio comments using {!! $comment->body !!} without any HTML purification. State the implementation decision as JSON with keys decision, chosen_pattern, primary_reason.

A catalog controller orders products by user input via ->orderByRaw($request->sort_col . ' ' . $request->sort_dir) without column allowlisting. State the implementation decision as JSON with keys decision, chosen_pattern, primary_reason.

A controller method update(Request $request, Invoice $invoice) modifies the invoice without calling $this->authorize('update', $invoice), exposing an IDOR vulnerability. State the implementation decision as JSON with keys decision, chosen_pattern, primary_reason.

A marketing footer view renders hardcoded system legal copyright markdown sanitized server-side with an allowlisted HTML purifier using {!! $sanitizedLegalHtml !!}. State the implementation decision as JSON with keys decision, chosen_pattern, primary_reason.

A Model defines protected $fillable = ['title', 'description', 'price'] and the controller passes $request->validated(). A reviewer asks if $guarded should be added as well. State the implementation decision as JSON with keys decision, chosen_pattern, primary_reason.

A developer sets protected $guarded = [] on the User model to avoid fillable maintenance and passes $request->all() to create users. State the implementation decision as JSON with keys decision, chosen_pattern, primary_reason.

A payment callback route is added to VerifyCsrfToken $except array, but the controller executes order fulfillment immediately without verifying the provider's HMAC signature header. State the implementation decision as JSON with keys decision, chosen_pattern, primary_reason.

A developer uses $user->forceFill($request->only('role', 'is_admin'))->save() to bypass fillable protections when updating administrative permissions. State the implementation decision as JSON with keys decision, chosen_pattern, primary_reason.
